mapper.sql: select a.answer_id, a.exam_id, a.question_id, a.my_answer, a.correct, a.score, pq.qtype, pq.title_snapshot as title, q.answer, q.analysis, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time from jc_edu_exam_answer a left join jc_edu_paper_question pq on pq.question_id = a.question_id and pq.paper_id = (select paper_id from jc_edu_exam where exam_id = a.exam_id) left join jc_edu_question q on q.question_id = a.question_id and q.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where a.correct = '0' and a.exam_id in (select exam_id from jc_edu_exam where person_id = #{personId} and del_flag = '0') order by a.create_time desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert:
insert into jc_edu_exam_answer ( exam_id, question_id, my_answer, correct, score, create_by, create_time, del_flag ) values
( #{item.examId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.myAnswer}, #{item.correct}, #{item.score}, #{item.createBy}, now(), '0' )
